thesisQuality.note: Record FY26 growth/margin execution plus multiyear NVIDIA purchase commitment support durable optical demand; concentration/content capture remain uncertain.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q4 revenue +34% YoY, gross-margin expansion and faster EPS growth; earlier FY26 debt paydown/refinancing improves funding evidence.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: September 2026 market cap about $62.1B after roughly doubling during 2026 makes valuation demanding despite strong growth; no favorable valuation assumption used.

catalystScore.note: NVIDIA multiyear purchase commitment/$2B investment, capacity expansion and multiple new growth platforms provide several source-supported catalysts.

governancePower.note: Management delivered growth/margin expansion, debt reduction and articulated disciplined capacity allocation; long-duration stewardship evidence is not yet exceptional.

alignment2036.note: Advanced optical connectivity is positioned as foundational for high-bandwidth energy-efficient AI infrastructure.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Broad photonics portfolio/manufacturing scale and datacenter/communications demand support reusable capabilities, but customer/channel diversification is not fully quantified.

bottleneckControl.note: NVIDIA capacity rights and purchase commitment plus Coherent capacity expansion indicate scarce qualified optical capacity, while agreement is nonexclusive.

scenarioRobustness.note: Broad photonics exposure offers several growth paths, but thesis remains materially tied to AI/datacenter optical intensity and execution.

substitutionResilience.note: Portfolio breadth and manufacturing scale support qualification barriers; nonexclusive sourcing and alternate architectures/suppliers cap the score.

supplyChainResilience.note: Capacity expansion is documented but reviewed evidence does not establish exceptional supplier/geographic redundancy; unknowns are treated conservatively.

pricingPower.note: Strong gross-margin expansion demonstrates improving value capture, but durable component-level price pass-through is not directly disclosed.

risk.note: Demand/capacity execution, customer/content concentration, substitution and valuation create meaningful risk.

confidence.note: Recent primary evidence is strong; independent market context exists; concentration, supply redundancy and pricing detail remain unknown.

thesis: Coherent combines improving operating execution with scarce optical capacity positioned for the AI infrastructure transition, but current valuation and unquantified concentration limit asymmetry.
keyRisk: AI optical demand or Coherent socket share underperforms capacity investment while valuation embeds aggressive growth.
nextCatalyst: FY27 capacity/new-platform ramps and conversion of the NVIDIA purchase commitment into sustained revenue/margin growth.

scoreBreakdown.note: Component weighted score under Methodology 1.0; risk and confidence remain separately explicit.
